name: tag_factor
note: REVIEW: a second-hand listing is tagged good_deal below median / tag_factor and priced_high above median x tag_factor. Band edges (about x1.5) would tag ~13% deal + ~26% high of normal prices on the 183 hand-checked friperie items (ridge); x2 tags 5.7% deal + 4.4% high with the SVR on 687 friperie pieces (183 hand-checked + 504 from public Instagram posts of 27 shops, Nov 2026)
